summary: Iteration 1: full backend (22 pytest cases) + mobile (390x844) frontend E2E testing of Cosa Fare a Potenza. 21/22 backend tests passed. The one failure is the login brute-force lockout, which never triggers because ingress proxy IPs change between requests. Everything else in the review request works: home/items filters, voting switch/cancel with no double counting, save, submissions (pending + SPOT code), spotted reactions/reply/code, register/login/me, the admin PIN and admin account, queue approve/edit-approve/reject, direct insert, feature, boost/reset, threshold changing display_count, PIN change invalidating old tokens, and the replies list. Every frontend flow tested passed. One layout overlap and a few UX issues were found.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout does not work behind the ingress. The lock key is f'{request.client.host}:{identifier}', and request.client.host is the ingress/proxy pod IP, which changes between requests (observed 10.208.133.66 and 10.208.133.69). Failed attempts are split across keys, so 6+ bad logins all return 401 and never 429. For the PIN, all users behind one proxy IP share a single lock bucket.

minor.issue: No rate limit on code guessing (6 hex chars = about 16.7M combinations). Consider reusing check_lock/register_fail.
instagram/info_link are not validated as http(s) URLs. Frontend renders them as <a href>, so a javascript: URL would run if an admin approves it.

ui_bugs.issue: The subtitle 'Verrà pubblicato dopo l'approvazione degli Admin' overlaps the 'Cambia tipo' back link (they render on top of each other).

issues: Uses the browser's native <input type=date/time> pickers. In this English-locale test browser they showed US format (10/16/2026, 10:00 PM) in an Italian UI; consider the shadcn Calendar or a forced it-IT format.
Location row duplicates the text when address == zone (e.g. 'Rione Santa Maria · Rione Santa Maria · Potenza'). Dedupe the joined values.
The frontend shows 6 trending rows while /api/home returns 10 (probably an intentional slice; just confirming).

action_items: Fix the brute-force key: use the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For first hop (fallback request.client.host), or key login lockout by identifier only. The same applies to the /admin/pin lock. Re-run TestAuth::test_brute_force.
Optional: validate instagram/info_link as http(s) URLs; rate-limit /api/spotted-code; dedupe the address/zone row; consider a localized date picker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 963 lines; split into routers (public, spotted, auth, admin, storage) per the >700-line guideline.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True. This works since auth uses Bearer tokens, but explicit origins are recommended.
Guest saves/votes (device id) are not merged into the account after register/login, so items a user saved as a guest disappear from Salvati after login.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes the admin password when it changes; bcrypt hashes start with $2b$. No httpOnly cookies are used (Bearer in localStorage), which is by design per the request.
react(): toggle uses delete then insert plus $inc. Concurrent double-taps can raise a DuplicateKeyError (500) on the unique index; wrap the insert in try/except.

rca of the issue: Brute force: the login_attempts collection showed two records for the same identifier with different IP prefixes ('10.208.133.66:nouser_x' count 3 and '10.208.133.69:nouser_x' count 3), so neither reached 5. Reproduce by POSTing /api/auth/login 6 times with a bad password: all return 401. Mitigation: derive the IP from X-Forwarded-For, or key by identifier.
